name: orbit
description: A globe of everything your Claude session talks to: tool calls, sockets and bytes traced to hosts, countries and orgs, with a deny-list that blocks before a call runs.

location.title: Your location
location.description: Latitude and longitude of the red dot, e.g. "49.28,-123.12 Vancouver". Empty: use /orbit locate once, or the globe centers on 0,0.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.description: off: watch only. denylist: block hosts and servers you listed with /orbit block. allowlist: block everything not allowed with /orbit allow. ask: ask about each new host (8 seconds, then deny).

picture.title: Globe picture
picture.description: auto: real pixels where the terminal draws them (kitty, Ghostty), colored half-blocks elsewhere. image or blocks force one.

geoDatabase.title: Geo database
geoDatabase.description: Path of a MaxMind-format city or country database (DB-IP Lite, GeoLite2). Empty: the DB-IP Lite files /orbit geodb downloads into ~/.claude/orbit/geo.

asnDatabase.title: ASN database
asnDatabase.description: Path of a MaxMind-format ASN database for the org column. Empty: the DB-IP ASN Lite file /orbit geodb downloads.

proxy.title: Proxy layer
proxy.description: Run a local HTTPS proxy for commands and MCP servers this session starts, so their hosts, bytes and latency are seen without decrypting anything. Sets HTTPS_PROXY for them.

fadeSeconds.title: Arc fade
fadeSeconds.description: How many seconds a finished connection's arc stays on the globe.

autoLog.title: Write the trace
autoLog.description: Keep the session's trace as JSONL in ~/.claude/orbit/traces, for /orbit replay.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show a count of hosts and countries on the status line.

node.title: Node path
node.description: The node executable for the geo and proxy helpers; empty looks on PATH.
